inputs.share_count_basis: 85.504m = FY2026 diluted weighted-average (note 4, includes unvested performance rights); 85.076m on issue at 30-Jun-2026. Grown 1.0%/yr for rights vesting and the DRP when it is next switched on (10-yr history 0.75%/yr; FY2026 +3.1% with the DRP active for one dividend). DRP/bonus plan is OFF for the FY2026 final dividend.
inputs.nta_note: Historical-cost NTA (annual report 5-year summary). Inventories $842.4m ($261.2m current / $581.2m non-current) are carried at the lower of cost and NRV; no mark-to-market uplift is assumed anywhere in the model.
inputs.presales_note: $830m contracted presales at 30-Jun-2026 (+26%), ~65% expected to settle in FY2027, balance FY2028/29; pipeline 9,651 undeveloped lots/units.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2026 OCF -$2.057m less PPE capex $1.086m. OCF before land acquisitions was +$97.0m; $99.1m went into land. Negative in 7 of 12 annual periods -- inventory build, not distress, and NOT the valuation base.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Owner-FCF arithmetic (reported FCF - SBC - interest received = -3.143 - 1.763 - 2.038) recorded for the contract only. This model does not discount FCF; see inputs.notes.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 annual report cash-flow note, share-based payments expense $1,763k (FY2025 $1,907k). Already expensed inside NPAT, so the earnings and NTA legs carry it; no separate deduction.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest received FY2026 $2.038m; inside NPAT, not stripped -- net debt is $157.7m so there is no net-cash pile to avoid double counting.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY, built in AUD: 10-yr ACGB ~4.3% + 5.5% ERP x beta 1.25 (small-cap cyclical developer) = 11.2%, rounded up to 12.0% for cyclicality/size. Flows (dividends, NPAT, NTA) are post-interest, so the discount rate is a cost of equity, not a WACC, and net debt is never deducted. One rate across scenarios; risk is charged in the bear flows and exit multiples, not a second time in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS-16 lease liabilities $3.3m are immaterial (0.6% of equity); lease cost sits inside NPAT and no adjustment is made.
inputs.nci_treatment: No material non-controlling interests; JV projects (QIC, Tokyo Gas RE Australia, WA government) are equity-accounted and their share of profit is inside NPAT.
inputs.notes: MODEL: blended NTA exit-P/B + earnings exit-P/E (dcf-methods routing row 'Land subdivider, inventory-heavy developer'; CDI.NZ is the precedent). WHY: Cedar Woods is a residential/commercial developer whose cash flow is settlement-timing lumpy and structurally reinvested into inventory ($842m of inventories against $545m of equity; FCF negative in 7 of 12 years, FY2026 OCF -$2.1m on a record $65.6m NPAT). An owner-FCF DCF off that series discounts land-bank reinvestment as if it were value destruction. The model instead (1) rolls book NTA forward at NPAT - dividends and exits at a market-anchored P/B, (2) capitalises year-5 NPAT at a market-anchored P/E, discounts dividends plus each exit at a 12% AUD cost of equity, and blends the legs 50/50. Exit multiples are anchored to CWP's own June-close history (P/B 0.82-1.46x, median 1.18x; P/E 8.4-13x ex-trough, median ~10.3x). SBC is expensed inside NPAT (AUD market, 0.35% of revenue), so house and street bases coincide and band_position is null. Price is the 22-Sep-2026 regular ASX close.

historical_growth.fcf_note: Owner FCF is negative at both ends of every window (FY2021 +$39.6m was a settlement-timing high, FY2026 -$6.9m); a CAGR is undefined and would be meaningless for a developer reinvesting into inventory.
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr -- the rate book NTA has compounded at with a ~50% payout; used only as a cross-check, the model is a bottom-up NPAT path + NTA roll-forward
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5-yr CAGR (13.9%) is more than double the equity CAGR (6.3%): FY2021 was a post-COVID low base and FY2026 a record-margin year (gross margin 30%, ROE 12.1% vs 10.2% 10-yr mean). The EPS CAGR describes the cycle, not the compounding rate; the base case fades ROE back toward the mean.
historical_growth.notes: SBC ($1.8m) is 2.7% of NPAT and flat, so there is no SBC-vs-earnings divergence to report.
historical_growth.multiples_note: Price = Yahoo monthly close for June of each year vs that FY's NTA/share and diluted EPS. FY2020 (20x) and FY2021 (16x) are trough-earnings P/Es; excluding them the P/E median is ~10.3x. P/B median 1.18x, FY2022-24 regime 0.82-0.97x.

base.narrative: FY2027 NPAT $75.5m = management's 15% growth target (25-Aug-2026), which is ~65% covered by the $830m presales book. FY2028 $72m holds near that level on the remaining presales and the presold apartment projects management says contribute in FY2028/29; FY2029-31 fade to $64-68m, i.e. ~9.5-10% ROE on a book that compounds at 50% retention -- the 10-year average ROE (10.2%), not the FY2026 record (12.1%). Payout 50% (FY2025 and FY2026 actual). Exit at 1.10x NTA / 10.0x earnings, slightly below CWP's 12-year June-close medians (1.18x / ~10.3x). Cost of equity 12%.

bull.narrative: Rate cuts in calendar 2027 (all Big-4 forecasts) plus the unresolved national housing shortage reopen an FY2016-19-style upcycle: NPAT $78m in FY2027 (small beat of guidance) compounding to $94m by FY2031, a 12.5% ROE on the larger book -- the level CWP earned in FY2017-19 and again in FY2026. Exit at 1.30x NTA / 11.5x earnings, the FY2018-19/FY2021 regime, still below the FY2015 high of 1.46x.

bear.narrative: The Q4-FY2026 slowdown management flagged persists and a builder failure or apartment-delivery delay slips settlements: FY2027 NPAT $60m misses guidance (-9% on FY2026), then a FY2020-scale trough ($42m, $35m -- 5.6% ROE, matching FY2020's 5.4%) before a partial recovery to $46m (~7% ROE) by FY2031. Payout held at 50% of the lower earnings, as through FY2020. Exit at 0.85x NTA / 8.0x earnings, the FY2022-24 de-rated regime (0.82-0.97x book).

entry_price.methodology: PV at 15% of FY2027-31 dividends per share plus PV at 15% of the year-5 blended exit value (50% NTA x exit P/B, 50% NPAT x exit P/E), each scenario on its own drivers. The exit multiples are market-observed (CWP's own trading regimes) rather than derived from a discount rate, so they are held constant between the 12% valuation and the 15% hurdle; only the discounting changes.

base.net_debt_note: recorded, NOT deducted: flows are post-interest and net debt already sits inside book NTA

sensitivity.note: Not a Gordon-growth DCF: axes are cost of equity (rows) and base-case year-5 exit P/B (columns), with the exit P/E scaled proportionally (10.0x at 1.10x book).

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25/50/25 rather than the house 15/50/35 default: a no-moat, high-cyclicality developer being valued off a record-earnings base, with management itself guiding to softer sales conditions through FY2027, does not earn a bull-skewed weighting. The bear case is a FY2020-scale earnings trough, not solvency (gearing 18.1%, interest cover 8.1x vs 2x covenant), which is why it is not weighted above 25%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide: SBC is expensed inside NPAT and is 0.35% of revenue, so the band collapses.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Cedar Woods is a land-and-built-form developer, not a cash-flow compounder: reported FCF has been negative in 7 of the last 12 years because cash flows into inventory (FY2026: +$97m operating cash before $99m of land purchases). The value of the business is the book NTA it carries (land at cost) plus the through-cycle return it earns on it (10-yr mean ROE 10.2%). The model therefore blends a NTA leg (NTA rolled forward at NPAT less a 50% payout, exited at a P/B anchored to CWP's own 12-year trading range) with an earnings leg (year-5 NPAT at an exit P/E from the same history), discounts at a 12% AUD cost of equity, and never deducts net debt (post-interest flows; net debt sits inside NTA). At $6.53 the stock is 1.03x NTA and 8.5x FY2026 diluted EPS -- roughly the base case ($6.05), which assumes FY2027 guidance is met and ROE then fades to its mean. The margin of safety is thin: the entry price at a 15% hurdle is $5.38.
key_risks_to_valuation: Residential cycle: management flagged softer sales through much of FY2027; a FY2020-scale trough (ROE 5.4%) is the bear case and is 25% weighted
Builder/contractor failure or apartment-delivery delay slipping presold settlements out of FY2027/28 (explicitly flagged 'elevated risk' in the annual report)
Exit multiples: the FY2022-24 regime priced CWP at 0.82-0.97x book; the base case's 1.10x assumes the market keeps paying near its long-run median
Net debt up 25.5% to $157.7m funding land acquisition (~49% unhedged); higher-for-longer rates hit both funding cost and buyer capacity
Land carried at cost with no NRV write-downs assumed; a sharp price fall in WA/QLD (the FY2026 strength) would hit both NTA and margins
Equity issuance: the DRP was switched on for one dividend in FY2026 (+3.1% shares); further raises to fund the acquisition pipeline dilute NTA/share
